excludedCandidates.rationale: Cube Infrastructure Managers invested in Boralex’s European renewable energy platform; despite Boralex being Canadian-listed, the investment scope and underlying assets are European and therefore out of North America scope.
Cube Hydro Partners is a U.S. hydropower platform associated with I Squared Capital and unrelated to Cube Infrastructure Managers despite similar naming.
Cube District Energy is a North American energy platform backed by I Squared Capital and is not affiliated with Cube Infrastructure Managers.

unresolvedConflicts.subject: Cube-branded infrastructure platforms in North America
unresolvedConflicts.issue: Multiple North American infrastructure platforms (e.g., Cube Hydro, Cube District Energy) use the Cube name but are not affiliated with Cube Infrastructure Managers, creating potential attribution confusion.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Maintain strict attribution to Cube Infrastructure Managers’ official portfolio disclosures and exclude similarly named but unaffiliated platforms.

notes: Official Cube Infrastructure Managers portfolio and strategy pages confirm a Europe-focused investment mandate with no disclosed North American direct infrastructure holdings.
Acquisition and exit searches across aliases and historical name (Natixis Environment & Infrastructure Luxembourg) yielded no North American investments.
All identifiable portfolio companies are European platforms or assets.
Name confusion with Cube Hydro and Cube District Energy resolved as unrelated to the manager.
